about: measure contests of 2018 in Hawaii, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, 2018 precinct-level returns, GitHub MEDSL/2018-elections-official at commit 42055b11dcd5
medsl.licence: no licence file in the repository; MEDSL's Dataverse sets of the same year are CC0 1.0
medsl.note: MEDSL's own earlier release, read by git (the repository now points to its Dataverse sets, which sit behind a guestbook; pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py --compare-dataverse matches the files by MD5); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2018-hi-precinct-general.zip

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

question.title: Con. Amend.: Public Education And Investment Real Property

p.not_computed: Haw. Const. art. XVII, §2 (ratification paragraph); §3 for the legislature: majority of the votes tallied on the question, and that majority must be at least 50% of the total vote cast at the election: the threshold turns on more than the yes share of those voting on the question, and the model forecasts that share only

threshold.rule: majority of the ballots cast upon the question in the affirmative
threshold.quote: If a majority of the ballots cast upon such a question be in the affirmative, delegates to the convention shall be chosen at the next regular election unless the legislature shall provide for the election of delegates at a special election.
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (convention)

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (83) for the class 'statewide measure'
